npcs.name: Lord Edric Vale
npcs.description: Lord holds down Vale Manor's receiving hall with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable noble patron are sent to Lord, who claims Vale Manor's receiving hall as home ground. At 48, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He offers wine before answers; neighbors joke that he would miss a coronation before misplacing the signet he twists when lying politely. Married to Mirelle; affair with Lysa; patron to Mayor. He is saving courage and coin alike to place Perrin in a marriage that secures river rights, while trying not to let scandal costing him council influence decide the ending. Misplaced a spare signet the same week Mira found one in a cloak hem.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; offers wine before answers.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to place Perrin in a marriage that secures river rights.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around: Misplaced a spare signet the same week Mira found one in a cloak hem.
npcs.rumor: Lord can open doors at Vale Manor's receiving hall after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the signet he twists when lying politely.

npcs.name: Lady Mirelle Vale
npcs.description: Local estate hostess whose days orbit the manor salon and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Before dawn touches the roofs, Lady is already at the manor salon, working as a estate hostess with flour, ink, sweat, or steel still on her fingers from yesterday. The habit everyone notices is simple: she rearranges flowers when displeased. Close by sits her prized invitation ledger with coded dots, a small anchor in a loud town. Edric's spouse; confides in Cressida. She wants to host the prince's envoy next season. She fears becoming a punchline in Cressida's circle more than open confrontation. A usable adventure hook trails her: Hired a private listener to watch the orangery path at night.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; rearranges flowers when displeased.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: host the prince's envoy next season.

npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Human features shaped by work at the manor salon; watch for the invitation ledger with coded dots.

npcs.name: Sir Halden Rook
npcs.description: Sir holds down the manor gate and tourneys with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Sir did not plan to become the town's go-to knight retainer, yet the manor gate and tourneys made the choice sticky. Now 37, the Human measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He checks his reflection in his blade, and keeps the favor ribbon he pretends is from a lady of standing like a confessor keeps secrets. Retainer to the Vales; uneasy. Hope pulls one way—earn land of his own through honest service—while caution pulls the other because of being ordered to cover Edric's sins. Saw Edric and Lysa in the orangery and chose silence—for now.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; checks his reflection in his blade.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to earn land of his own through honest service.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around: Saw Edric and Lysa in the orangery and chose silence—for now.
npcs.rumor: Sir can open doors at the manor gate and tourneys after hours—if asked the right way.

npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the favor ribbon he pretends is from a lady of standing.

npcs.name: Cressida Fenn
npcs.description: Local court gossip whose days orbit tea tables and balcony whispers and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable court gossip are sent to Cressida, who claims tea tables and balcony whispers as home ground. At 33, this Half-Elf has learned to watch hands before faces. She laughs softly at secrets she already knew; neighbors joke that she would miss a coronation before misplacing the fan with a hollow rivet for notes. Confidante to Mirelle; plays both sides. She is saving courage and coin alike to become the town's indispensable matchmaker of alliances, while trying not to let backing the wrong Vale in a house split decide the ending. Sold a rumor about Lysa to Kitty Shade for theater tickets and leverage.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; laughs softly at secrets she already knew.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: become the town's indispensable matchmaker of alliances.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Sold a rumor about Lysa to Kitty Shade for theater tickets and leverage.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near tea tables and balcony whispers on a night Cressida worked late.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Half-Elf features shaped by work at tea tables and balcony whispers; watch for the fan with a hollow rivet for notes.

npcs.name: Baron Torvald Ash
npcs.description: The mining magnate people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Baron Torvald Ash keeps a stone townhouse smelling of ore running with the stubborn patience of a 140-year-old Dwarf who has already survived worse seasons than this one. He weighs coins on a pocket scale mid-conversation, and the nugget pendant from his first profitable shaft is usually within reach when tempers rise. Business rival/partner talks with Edric. His private aim is plain enough: buy river docking rights from Edric. Still, he flinches at the thought of sabotage in the mines blamed on 'adventurers'. Lately the trouble under his nose is this: Suspects Orrin's 'spice losses' are cover for ore theft.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; weighs coins on a pocket scale mid-conversation.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to buy river docking rights from Edric.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to sabotage in the mines blamed on 'adventurers', especially since: Suspects Orrin's 'spice losses' are cover for ore theft.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near a stone townhouse smelling of ore on a night Baron worked late.
npcs.voice: Quick river-town diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near a stone townhouse smelling of ore: dwarf, practical layers, and that nugget pendant from his first profitable shaft.

npcs.name: Lysa Thorne
npcs.description: A lady-in-waiting rooted at side corridors of Vale Manor, known for how she checks over her shoulder before she smiles.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable lady-in-waiting are sent to Lysa, who claims side corridors of Vale Manor as home ground. At 28, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. She checks over her shoulder before she smiles; neighbors joke that she would miss a coronation before misplacing the locket with a blank painted face. Affair with Edric; client of Hedda. She is saving courage and coin alike to leave town with enough coin to vanish kindly, while trying not to let Mirelle's private listener decide the ending. Tried to pawn Edric's gift ring; Lina almost recognized the crest.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; checks over her shoulder before she smiles.
npcs.motivation: To leave town with enough coin to vanish kindly without feeding Mirelle's private listener.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than she admits: Tried to pawn Edric's gift ring; Lina almost recognized the crest.
npcs.rumor: The locket with a blank painted face once belonged to a person who vanished upriver.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A human silhouette framed by side corridors of Vale Manor, hands seldom empty of the locket with a blank painted face.

npcs.name: Perrin Vale
npcs.description: Familiar face at fencing yards and tavern galleries; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable heir apparent are sent to Perrin, who claims fencing yards and tavern galleries as home ground. At 17, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He challenges anyone who calls him 'boy'; neighbors joke that he would miss a coronation before misplacing the practice rapier with a noble wire wrap. Heir; trained illicitly by Hobb's yard. He is saving courage and coin alike to win a real duel that makes minstrels sing, while trying not to let being married off before he sees the world decide the ending. Paid Cal for introductions to 'dangerous friends'.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; challenges anyone who calls him 'boy'.
npcs.motivation: Protect his place at fencing yards and tavern galleries long enough to win a real duel that makes minstrels sing.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that paid Cal for introductions to 'dangerous friends'.
npcs.rumor: The practice rapier with a noble wire wrap once belonged to a person who vanished upriver.
npcs.voice: Measured human cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn human garb; practice rapier with a noble wire wrap always nearby.

npcs.name: Dame Orla Quince
npcs.description: Local salon patron whose days orbit an old elf-owned townhouse gallery and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Before dawn touches the roofs, Dame is already at an old elf-owned townhouse gallery, working as a salon patron with flour, ink, sweat, or steel still on her fingers from yesterday. The habit everyone notices is simple: she corrects pronunciation of dead poets. Close by sits her prized portrait collection with one face turned to the wall, a small anchor in a loud town. Patron of arts; employs Cressida's gossip. She wants to fund a public theater that outlives gossip. She fears mortality fashion among humans rushing her into patronage mistakes more than open confrontation. A usable adventure hook trails her: Commissioned Nessa to sing a satire soft enough to sting Edric.

npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: fund a public theater that outlives gossip.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Commissioned Nessa to sing a satire soft enough to sting Edric.
npcs.rumor: Someone paid Dame to forget a name connected to an old elf-owned townhouse gallery.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Elf features shaped by work at an old elf-owned townhouse gallery; watch for the portrait collection with one face turned to the wall.
